Question regarding the counting of days abroad:
I was told in the partner visa interview contradicting information regarding how the count of days abroad is calculated.
On the partner visa the non-israeli has to be no more than 25% of the year abroad (correct me if I'm wrong).
We received the visa Feb 10th 2026. Is the count starting from that day, or the calendar year, i.e. 1.1.26? 
Thank you all
